card.name: Small words inside instruction sentences
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, from, the, at, may) and punctuation inside patient or prescriber instructions, especially about procedures, driving, or timing. Also the dot in section numbers like 8.1 in contraindication lists.

modes.label: Linking words in instructions
modes.description: A small word such as to, from, the, at or may in the middle of an instruction sentence about what a patient must do or avoid.

modes.label: Section number dots
modes.description: The period inside a cross-reference number in a contraindications list.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS • Pregnancy ( Boxed Warning , 4.1 , 5.1 , 8<<.>>1 ). • Demonstrated severe hypersensitivity

modes.label: Start of a verb phrase
modes.description: A word partway into a heading or instruction, such as requiring or remove.
modes.example: 5.7 Activities Re<<quiring>> Mental Alertness: Risks of Driving

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words inside instructions telling the patient what to do or avoid, and on dots in section numbers.
